bugs.error_message: Chunked upload resume restarts from byte 0 instead of continuing from last uploaded offset
bugs.root_cause: UploadChunkedAsync always started from chunkIndex=0 and UploadFileAsync reset progress to 0 on every call including resume. No UploadedBytes tracking existed on UploadFileInfo.
bugs.fix: Added UploadedBytes property to UploadFileInfo. UploadChunkedAsync now calculates startChunk from UploadedBytes, skips already-read bytes in the stream, and updates UploadedBytes after each successful chunk. UploadFileAsync skips progress reset when resuming. RetryFile resets UploadedBytes to 0.
